Category.title: Category
Category.description: A soundboard category tab used to organize sound pads.

name.description: Display name of the category tab.

order.description: Sort order index of the category tab.

SoundPad.title: SoundPad
SoundPad.description: An individual sound pad tile on the basketball PA soundboard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sound pad.

title.description: Display name shown in the center of the sound pad.

categoryId.description: ID of the category tab this pad belongs to.

order.description: Sort order index within the soundboard grid.

color.description: Hex background color for the pad.

playbackMode.description: Playback behavior: retrigger restarts on tap; toggle starts/stops; gate plays while held and stops on release.

audioUrl.description: Firebase Storage or audio download URL.

storagePath.description: Firebase Storage object path if uploaded.

synthPreset.description: Built-in Web Audio synthesizer preset ID for starter/instant pads.

clipStartSec.description: Optional start trim offset in seconds for audio playback (>= 0).

clipEndSec.description: Optional end trim point in seconds for audio playback (0 means play to natural end).

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Soundboard category tabs synced across devices.

/sounds/{soundId}.description: Soundboard pad tiles synced across devices.
